population_surface.calibration_target: Census 2022 (MBS yearbook 3.3) scaled to the 2022 mid-year projection for Male' City (table 3.16)
limitations: island totals are published census counts; the within-island split is a building-footprint x storeys proxy
building:levels is present on a minority of footprints; storeys are inferred by type for the rest
Villimale' is out of scope and is not fetched or scored

network.scope: R1-R9 in scope. R5/R6 replaced by loops. R10-R12 excluded from both networks (no captured departures). Villimalé out of scope.

fleet.allocation: one bus per route, the rest by largest remainder on peak demand
fleet.headway_rule: cycle_time / buses, so the fleet constrains the service

demand_level.shape: Avas taxi OD, Saturday, scaled to the MTCC level

airport_stream.note: a judgement, not a measurement; both networks receive the same stream
